items.text: Lamar Jackson day-to-day with ankle injury; left stadium in protective boot, questionable to return in-game then monitored next week.
items.why: Ankle injury mid-game; Huntley in; boot post-game.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 5; Ravens offense impacted rest of game and potentially next.
items.opportunity: If sits next, Huntley or backup QB stream; Henry/Flowers usage shifts.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase ruled OUT due to concussion after being evaluated mid-game.
items.why: Concussion protocol evaluation during Bengals game.
items.implication: Tee Higgins and other CIN WRs see full target share rest of game; Chase likely misses time pending protocol.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Tee Higgins and CIN pass-catchers.

items.text: Saquon Barkley downgraded to OUT with hamstring injury after initially being questionable to return.
items.why: Hamstring injury sustained in game; Eagles officially downgraded him.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee or backups elevated for remaining snaps; major fantasy zero for the week.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Eagles backup RBs in remaining game and potentially next if lingering.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Expected Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD Mike Evans; Not expected Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen; Bagent starting.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for key fantasy statuses.
items.implication: Core active/inactive guidance aligning with Schefter/Rap; parse all listed.
items.opportunity: Confidence in starting expected players; fade not-expected.

items.text: Terry McLaurin officially inactive vs Colts in London due to hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring injury; not expected to play per pregame reports.
items.implication: WAS WR targets redistribute; Deebo Samuel or others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/target share for remaining Commanders WRs.

items.text: Tyquan Thornton suffered dislocated ankle (reset), out indefinitely; made plane, full eval/second opinion morning; best game of career (111 yds 2 TDs) before exit.
items.implication: KC WR depth thinner long-term; more for Rice (if healthy)/Worthy.
items.opportunity: Sustained bump for remaining Chiefs receivers.

items.text: Post-Sunday injury watch: Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring), Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot), DJ Moore (shoulder), Pat Bryant (ankle), others.
items.why: Compiled list of players to monitor after Sunday games for next week impact.
items.implication: Key for waivers/ROS; many high-value players dinged.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and backups for listed OUT/injured; status changes pending.

items.text: DJ Moore aggravated shoulder injury; not considered long-term issue currently.
items.implication: Monitor Week 5 availability; short-term concern only so far.
items.opportunity: If limited next, other BUF WRs elevated.

items.why: Confirmed inactive aligning with ETR not expected.
items.implication: CAR WR depth elevated; Tetairoa McMillan primary.
items.opportunity: More targets for McMillan and other Panthers WRs.

items.text: Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring.
items.implication: Likely out or very limited; KC WR targets to Worthy/others.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for Xavier Worthy and KC pass catchers.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is active for Chargers despite foot/ribs concerns.
items.why: Cleared to play; ETR noted bigger dock but active confirmation.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected though docked in projections for injury.
items.opportunity: Maintains high target share if no further aggravation.

items.text: Mike Evans officially active after GTD/optimistic status with ribs; practiced late week.
items.why: Optimistic reports and late practice; bigger dock in ETR projections for ribs.
items.implication: Playable but monitor for limited snaps/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets if no further issue; reverse any backup beneficiaries.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal/Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.why: Multiple absences stacking; Johnson added Q for personal reasons.
items.implication: PHI offense depleted; Hurts protection and pass-catchers impacted; AJ Brown/others more volume but less efficient.
items.opportunity: Potential upside for remaining skill if volume concentrates; OL issues hurt run/pass.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin); Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Expected to play.
items.why: Schefter report of no workload limit; ETR projecting with minimal dock.
items.implication: Near full projection; strong WR1 play if active as expected.

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected to have hard pitch count. Expected to play.
items.why: Beat report no hard pitch count; ETR minimal dock.
items.opportunity: Maintained route share without strict limit.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (maintenance, not new injury); limited second-half snaps in close game despite wanting more.
items.why: Coaches managing workload/body for long season; Love honest about not 100% feel.
items.implication: Ongoing snap limits reduce fantasy ceiling; committee or situational use.
items.opportunity: Backups or other ARI RBs may see goal-line/crucial snaps.
items.conflict: Talent high but role capped by management.

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten had not one but two touchdowns called back due to penalty.
items.why: In-game observation of near-scores wiped by flags.
items.implication: Usage present and red-zone involved; unlucky fantasy day but role signal positive.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone work confirmed for JAC RB.

items.text: Projecting Kenyon Sadiq (back) in with very little injury dock; Colby Parkinson out. Waiting confirmation.
items.why: No contrary reports; little dock in ETR projections.
items.implication: TE opportunity if confirmed active; Parkinson absence helps.
items.opportunity: Potential streaming TE snaps/routes for Sadiq.
